usage: The word 踩滑板 is a noun referring to the sport or activity of skateboarding.
You can use 踩滑板 to talk about the physical skateboard or the action of skateboarding.
In a sentence, 踩滑板 often acts as the subject or object when discussing sports or leisure activities.
It can be combined with verbs like 學 (to learn) or 玩 (to play) to describe actions related to skateboarding.
When describing the location or place related to skateboarding, you can put 踩滑板 before a location noun e.g., 踩滑板場 (skateboard park).
